decisions.reason: Prioritizing conversion performance does not replace or alter the existing requirement for a viral creative style.
The source establishes an overall optimization priority but does not change the required directness or Indian-market alignment of the opening hook.
The conversion priority does not change the existing instruction to use the latest reference script as the foundation and improve it with stronger, unique material.
The word performance refers to campaign conversion performance, not lip-sync accuracy or facial performance.
The source does not alter the required reference basis, keyword usage, message fidelity, or revision style.
An overall conversion objective is compatible with, but does not modify, the existing requirement for retention-focused cuts.
The source does not change the defined audience age range or the requirement's Indian-market context.
The conversion priority does not change the required source or presentation of testimonial material.
The source does not modify the existing requirement for a clear call to action integrated naturally into the edit.
Prioritizing conversion over appearance does not resolve or modify the existing production-method conflict concerning live-action and AI-generated footage.
